description: HookLayer helps creators, marketers, and agencies analyze Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube accounts. It audits account performance, finds high-performing videos, identifies recurring hooks and viral patterns, scores content ideas, and turns proven formats into original hooks, scripts, and ready-to-film concepts. Use it to understand what is working, why it works, and what to create next.
